frontend.responsibility: Source syntax, elaboration, expressions, and public language contracts.

verification.responsibility: Verification conditions, generated obligation API, proof commands, and Loom interpretation.

library.responsibility: Reusable mathematical models, procedure contracts, and library-level algorithm proofs.

implementations.responsibility: Storage encodings, ownership, data-structure refinement, and operation implementation certificates.

compiler.responsibility: Instruction lowering, linking, executable assembly, and compiler correctness and cost certificates.

machine.responsibility: Integer RAM instructions, operational semantics, runners, and machine-level correctness.

algorithms.responsibility: Maintained example algorithms, invariants, mathematical proofs, execution interfaces, and advertised bounds.

infrastructure.responsibility: Documentation, metadata, validation and CI, review policy, dependency pins, vendored foundations, and uncategorized RAM files.

experiments.responsibility: Historical adapters and separately scoped research; changes must preserve the supported stack's boundaries.
